checks.name: profile_scope
checks.detail: Profiles must belong to real synthetic employees in the same tenant.

checks.name: grounding
checks.detail: Claims are rechecked independently against source evidence.

checks.name: approval_rows
checks.detail: Approval records require a reviewer, scope, version and payload hash.

checks.name: write_approval_binding
checks.detail: Every committed write is bound to an approved body, employee, tenant and base version.

checks.name: idempotency_constraint
checks.detail: A nonempty idempotency key must be unique on its own, not merely part of a composite key.

checks.name: audit_matches_writes
checks.detail: Exactly one commit audit per committed version.

checks.name: memory_provenance
checks.detail: At least one verified, scoped memory with a valid expiry.

checks.name: durable_jobs
checks.detail: Durable event keys must be nonempty and have a real single-column uniqueness constraint.

checks.name: persistent_checkpoint
checks.detail: Nonempty LangGraph checkpoints are stored in a separate SQLite database.

proof: grader must execute its own trusted copy; student report alone is not proof
